label: GO after a rewarded trial, upcoming a2 choice, mid-to-late episode
explanation: Strictly gated: fires only at GO steps whose D1 showed a reward (GO & prev_reward==1 has recall 1.0, mass recall 1.0, but precision 0.18). Within that gate it prefers the agent choosing a2 (model_act==2 lift 4.4x, strongly negative choice logit; 73% of mass on a2) and is strongly modulated by episode time: almost silent in trials 0-30, peaks in trials 50-79, fades after 85. Activation tends to grow over consecutive rewarded trials within a window and resets after an unrewarded one. It never fires at D1 or D2, or after an unrewarded trial. The recorded predicate uses the agent own upcoming choice (legitimate) and episode trial index; it is not a clean single concept (dev F1 0.57, mass recall 0.54), so partially explained. Reward of the current trial and transition type carry no signal.
